Field lore / 112-unit original

Field trip

brand-field.svg

A squat CRT rides a checkerboard deck. The asymmetrical perspective, fat underside, vent cuts, and little wheels give programmable work a physical life.

VibeField’s editorial mascot: a terminal taking the field with it.

05 / Notes from the print shop

MADE OF
FIELD LORE.

01 / OBJECTS WITH A PAST

CRTs, coiled leads, tapes, floppy labels, record crates, and carpenter’s pencils. Old technology gives the invisible agent world objects you can almost hold.

02 / A LITTLE BAD MANNERS

Offset eyes. Skewed perspective. Overweight black shadows. A brain with a plug. The drawings use visual jokes and mismatched silhouettes to earn a place on a laptop lid.

03 / A PRINTED FAMILY

The lesson from Stink Dings is a collection with a point of view. These are new paths, made for VibeField: bold ink, open paper, small scratches, and a white die-cut edge.

78 editable SVGs in two finishes, a sprite, shared React components, and the complete drawing source. The primary logo stays exact. Account-face and agent-role assignment remain proposals.
